Monthly sales reporting shouldn't eat an afternoon.

Work Saban's first free tool lets you choose a sales CSV and turn it into a monthly report. Everything runs locally in your browser.

The report can be downloaded, and the calculations are checked a second time. No account, file upload or payment.

Try the tool with a sample CSV and tell us what repetitive reporting task you want simplified next. Broader AI-team features remain in development. Find the tool link in the first comment.

A sales report is better when you can check it.

Work Saban groups revenues by month from your sales CSV, checks the arithmetic again, and offers a report you can download.

This is not a financial audit or an autonomous AI workforce. It's a free browser-based reporting tool that works with a simple CSV format.

Use the example CSV first, then tell us whether clarity, monthly comparisons or fewer spreadsheet chores would help your team most. Find the tool link in the first comment.

We're building toward coordinated AI teams, but we'll keep unsupported features clearly marked as development work.

If you repeat a reporting task every month, tell us what the finished report should look like. Written private-pilot inquiries are open on our product page. Find the tool link in the first comment.
